dorsal_fin_geometric_silhouette.falcation_vector: Moderate concavity along the trailing edge, following a smooth spline from the apex to the posterior insertion point.
dorsal_fin_geometric_silhouette.apex_bounding_geometry: Rounded morphological point with a broad radius, classified as obtuse.
dorsal_fin_geometric_silhouette.leading_edge_angle: Approximately 55 degrees relative to the horizontal dorsal ridge line.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Visible white superficial linear markings (rake marks) on the lower left anterior flank and small irregular indentation on the posterior edge of the apex.
